inicio.queEs: A team is a group of people and their to-dos. You're added automatically.
inicio.loMioAyuda: Everything open that is yours, across all your teams and your personal space.
inicio.sinPendientes: Nothing pending. Write one above or open a team.
inicio.tuEspacio: Your space: only you can see it
inicio.personalAyuda: Your own to-dos, with no team: only you can see them. Once you have a personal space, the quick line on this screen saves there.

tablero.sinMios: You have no open to-dos. Write one above with @{alias}.
tablero.hechasN: {n, plural, one {# to-do done} other {# to-dos done}}

tarjeta.vinculada: {n, plural, one {Also in # more team} other {Also in # more teams}}

barra.creados: {n, plural, one {To-do created ✓} other {# to-dos created ✓}}
barra.atajos: ↑ ↓ to move · Enter or Tab to pick · Esc to close
ejemplos: @{a} finish the sales report this week #sales
@{a} prepare the client demo on monday !
@{a} @{b} tidy up the team drive in 3 days

errores.faltaTitulo: Missing title: write what needs to be done.
errores.vacio: Write something or attach an image.
errores.sinHojas: The Excel file has no sheets.
errores.tipoNoPermitido: "{nombre}": that file type cannot be uploaded.

tarea.confirmarBorrar: Delete this to-do with its comments and images? This can't be undone.
tarea.vinculadosAyuda: They are linked: changing the stage, title, description, date or priority in one changes the others. Assignees, tags and comments belong to each team.
tarea.copiarAyuda: Creates a linked twin in that team: they share stage and content
tarea.moverAyuda: Takes the to-do with its whole history; it leaves this team
tarea.confirmarMover: Move this to-do to "{equipo}"? It will disappear from this team.

historial.enlaces: {n, plural, =0 {removed the links} one {left # link} other {left # links}}

comentarios.placeholder: Comment on progress… Paste or drop images or files here.
comentarios.tiposAyuda: images, PDF, Office, CSV, text or zip · up to {mb} MB

miembros.confirmarQuitar: Remove {nombre} from the team? Their to-dos stay.
miembros.etapasAyuda: The board columns, in order. The one marked as done closes the to-do.
miembros.tienePendientes: It has to-dos: move them first
miembros.sinCuentaAyuda: They will see the team once they create their account with this email.
miembros.invitarAyuda: The email they signed up with (or will sign up with). Several are fine.
miembros.etapasOrden: To reorder, drag them by the handle or use the arrows.
miembros.invitacionTexto: I invited you to the "{equipo}" team on Flujo: {enlace}
miembros.invitarCorreo: They will get an email with the link.
miembros.invitarSinCorreo: Flujo does not send emails: copy the invitation link (the icon next to each member) and send it yourself.

importar.intro: Bring in a list you already keep somewhere else: a spreadsheet, a document, meeting notes.
importar.paso1: Ask your AI to organize your to-dos
importar.paso1Ayuda: Copy this request, paste it into Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini together with your list (an Excel, a CSV, notes, anything) and it will return a CSV ready for Flujo.
importar.paso2: Paste what it returned, or upload the file
importar.paso2Ayuda: A CSV with headers, an Excel (.xlsx) with the same columns, or a simple list with one line per to-do:
importar.placeholder:
title,assignees,due_date,tags,priority,stage,description
Send proposal to Liverpool,Marco,2026-09-30,sales,high,,

— or —

- @andrea prepare Coppel demo on monday #sales
- tidy up the team drive
importar.listos: {n, plural, one {# to-do ready} other {# to-dos ready}}
importar.omitidos: {n} without a title will be skipped
importar.avisosNota: Warnings don't block the import; whatever wasn't understood stays empty and can be edited later.
importar.listo: {n, plural, one {Done: # to-do created} other {Done: # to-dos created}}

avisos.etapaNoExiste: The stage “{valor}” doesn't exist; goes to the first one

importar.etiquetasAyuda: If the AI added too many, remove them here (from every to-do) or one by one in the table.
importar.soloPrimera: Keep only the first tag of each to-do

registro.nota: If someone already invited you to a team with this email, you will see it once you sign in.

errores.yaExiste: There is already an account with that email.

registro.invitado: You were invited to the {equipo} team. Create your account with this email and you will see it once you sign in.

cuenta.correoFijo: (can't be changed: it's how teams invite you)

errores.actualIncorrecta: The current password is not correct.

exportar.ayuda: Every to-do of the team, with assignees, dates, tags, links and comments, in whatever format suits you.
exportar.mdAyuda: to paste into Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini
exportar.csvAyuda: for spreadsheets; can be imported back
exportar.xlsxAyuda: the same table, ready to open

pasar.ayuda: To take what you have here to another of your teams, for example a new one with your area.
pasar.sinDestino: You don't have another team to send them to yet.
pasar.nota: Copying creates linked twins (without comments or attachments): changing the stage or content in one changes the other. Moving takes their whole history along. Stages are matched by name (if none matches, the first one) and assignees who are not in the other team are dropped.

boton.copiar: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing to copy} one {Copy # to-do to {equipo}} other {Copy # to-dos to {equipo}}}
boton.mover: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing to move} one {Move # to-do to {equipo}} other {Move # to-dos to {equipo}}}

pasar.confirmarMover: Move {n} to-dos to "{equipo}"? They will disappear from this team.

listo.copiar: {n, plural, one {Done: # to-do copied to {equipo}.} other {Done: # to-dos copied to {equipo}.}}
listo.mover: {n, plural, one {Done: # to-do moved to {equipo}.} other {Done: # to-dos moved to {equipo}.}}

invitacion.asunto: {quien} invited you to the "{equipo}" team on Flujo
invitacion.cuerpo: {quien} added you to the "{equipo}" team on Flujo, the team to-do app.
invitacion.crearCuenta: Create your account with this email ({email}) and you will see the team once you sign in:
invitacion.entrar: You already have an account: sign in and the team is there:
invitacion.pie: If you were not expecting this email, you can ignore it.
invitacion.titulo: You were invited to the "{equipo}" team
invitacion.oEnlace: If the button does not work, paste this link in your browser:
invitacion.firma: Flujo · the team’s to-dos, in one place.
